description: Call the model with the conversation and tools, run its tool calls, append the results, repeat until a final answer or another stop condition.
Reason + act: the model alternates reasoning and tool actions, treating each tool result as a new observation. The research origin of the agent loop.
The identifier that ties a tool result message to the call that requested it; one result per id is sent before the next model turn.
A tool result that describes a failure (unknown tool, invalid arguments, exception) in words the model can act on, instead of crashing the loop.
A model reply with no tool calls; the normal way an agent loop ends.
The maximum number of model calls in one run; the minimum budget every loop needs.
